caption: The drawing features three human figures and two animal figures positioned on a rectangular platform. The largest human figure is in the center, wearing a brown coat with yellow and green trim, brown trousers, and black shoes. This figure has long black hair and a beard, and is holding a green staff decorated with pink and yellow ornaments. To the left of the central figure is a smaller human figure dressed in a green garment with a white collar, white cuffs, and a gold crown or hat. This smaller figure is holding a thin leash connected to two white and black-spotted animals positioned on the right side of the platform. These animals resemble cows or oxen and have golden horns, black hooves, expressive eyes, and are yoked together with a bar attached to the platform. The entire composition is set on a green, brown, and beige colored base that appears worn or distressed in some areas, with visible texture and color variation. In the lower left corner, there is a handwritten signature and date: "Lanzini Aug. 29, 1938."
title: Bulto
